title: Three Years and Over 100 No's Before Canva's First Investment
conflicts: Seed money: $3M round with a Commercialisation Australia contribution (SmartCompany, March 2013) vs $1.5M matched by government (CNBC 2020) vs $3M from investors plus a separate $2M Commercialisation Australia investment (Women's Agenda 2024); story uses the contemporary $3M with an unquantified grant. First-year users: 600,000 (Women's Agenda) vs 150,000 active (Gulf News); neither used. Fundraising length: 'almost a year' (SmartCompany 2013) vs Perkins's 'three years between meeting our first investor and actually landing an investment' (2016); reconciled as 2010 meeting to 2013 close. Tai: lead investor (Women's Agenda) vs one of several (SmartCompany); story lists him among investors. Over 100 rejections is Perkins's own count.
notes: Episode kept (2010-2013 fundraising). Quote stance: challenges (Zhuangzi's gambler distracted by the stake vs years of seeking outside money). This is my one edition that mentions talQen (in the reflection, on leading a pitch with the problem).
